about.title: D, E, F
about.length_note: Three letters, a quick look back at A to C and a short wrap-up fit in about 10 minutes. Take your time. You can pause after any letter and come back later.

say.text: Welcome back. Today we meet three letters: D, E and F. There is no hurry. You can stop and rest whenever you like.
First, a quick look back. Last time we met A, B and C. A says 'a' as in apple. B says 'b' as in ball. C says 'k' as in cat.

show.text:
A a: apple
B b: ball
C c: cat

say.text: Let's try one. Which letter is the first letter of 'ball'?

show.text:
A a: apple
B b: ball
C c: cat

ask.q: Which letter does the word 'ball' start with?
ask.why: 'Ball' starts with the 'b' sound, and that is the letter B.

say.text: Now our first new letter: D. The name of the letter is 'dee'. The big letter D is a straight line down, with a round belly on the right.
The small letter d is a round circle with a tall line on its right side. Be careful: the small b looks like it, but the line is on the left. For d, the round part comes first, then the tall line.

show.text: A small round circle with a tall straight line standing on its right side, making the letter d. Beside it, the letter b with its line on the left, shown faded for comparison.

say.text: D makes a short sound, 'd', like at the start of 'dog'. Put your tongue behind your top teeth and say 'd, d, dog'. A grown-up word is 'doctor'.

ask.q: Which word starts with the 'd' sound?
ask.why: 'Dog' starts with 'd'. 'Fish' starts with F, 'egg' with E and 'cat' with C.

say.text: Next: E. The name of the letter is 'ee'. The big letter E is one tall line with three short arms pointing to the right.
The small letter e is a little circle with a bar across the middle. It has an open mouth at the lower right.

show.text: A small round letter e: a short straight bar across the middle of a circle, with a gap at the lower right.

say.text: E has more than one sound. The most common one is short: 'eh', as in 'egg'. Say it with me: 'eh, eh, egg'. A grown-up word is 'envelope'.

show.text:
E e — egg
sound: eh
(grown-up word: envelope)

say.text: E can also say its own name, 'ee', as in 'eat'. You will see both. Start with 'eh' as in egg, and learn the other one slowly.

show.text:
Common sound: eh — egg
Second sound: ee — eat

ask.q: What is the most common sound for the letter E, as in 'egg'?
ask.why: The short sound 'eh', as in 'egg', is the one to learn first. 'Dee' is the name of D, 'fff' is the sound of F, and 'kuh' is a sound of C.

say.text: Our last letter today: F. The name of the letter is 'eff'. The big letter F is a tall line with two arms to the right, one at the top and one in the middle. It looks like E with the bottom arm missing.
The small letter f is a tall line with a hook at the top, like a walking stick, and a short bar across it.

show.text: A tall small letter f: a straight line with a curved hook at the top, and a short cross bar through the middle.

say.text: F makes a soft sound, 'fff', like blowing on hot soup. Your top teeth touch your bottom lip. Say 'fff, fff, fish'. A grown-up word is 'family'.

show.text:
F f — fish
sound: fff
(grown-up word: family)

ask.q: Which word starts with the 'fff' sound?
ask.why: 'Fish' starts with 'fff'. The others start with D, E and B.

say.text: Now let's match big and small letters. Each big letter has a small partner.

show.text:
D — d
E — e
F — f

ask.q: Which small letter is the partner of the big letter D?
ask.why: The big D partners with the small d. The small b looks similar, but its tall line is on the left.

say.text: Well done. Today you met D for dog, E for egg and F for fish. Next time we meet G, H and I. Rest now, and come back when you are ready.

show.text:
D d — dog
E e — egg
F f — fish
